name: presenter-copilot
description: Local-first AI copilot for high-stakes presentations

scripts.test: pnpm --filter @presenter-copilot/desktop test && uv run --directory core --project . --locked python -m pytest
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @presenter-copilot/desktop lint && uv run --directory core --project . --locked ruff check presenter_core tests
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @presenter-copilot/desktop typecheck && uv run --directory core --project . --locked mypy presenter_core
scripts.format: pnpm --filter @presenter-copilot/desktop format && uv run --directory core --project . --locked ruff format presenter_core tests
scripts.format:check: pnpm --filter @presenter-copilot/desktop format:check && uv run --directory core --project . --locked ruff format --check presenter_core tests
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
scripts.setup: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm --filter @presenter-copilot/desktop exec electron --version && uv sync --project core --locked
scripts.test:m9: uv run --directory core --project . --locked python -m pytest tests/test_m9_release.py -q
scripts.test:privacy-network: uv run --directory core --project . --locked python -m pytest tests/test_m8_privacy.py -q
scripts.package:win: pnpm build:sidecar && pnpm build && pnpm --filter @presenter-copilot/desktop exec electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.yml
